{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patients: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicates.index.tolist()}")

# Check if 'severe' exists in severity column
print(f"Unique severity levels: {sorted(df['severity'].unique())}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline (just to confirm sentinel)
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")"}
